entry.name: rnbo_mtof
entry.digest: Convert between MIDI notes and frequencies.
entry.description: Convert a MIDI note number to frequency, reported as a float in Hertz (Hz), with support for the Scala file format for musical tunings.

arguments.name: scalename
arguments.description: Defining a symbol argument for the mtof object will cause mtof to calculate the MIDI to frequency conversion based on a given scale from the scala archive. The scale name should be the filename from the scala archive, but without the file extension. For example, if the scale in the scala archive is listed as, you can give mtof the argument.
